title: Understanding Harmful Communication (Father-Focused)
description: This course supports fathers to recognise communication behaviours that create fear or emotional instability for partners and children.
learningOutcomes: Identify harmful communication patterns used in parenting and relationships.
Understand how tone and language affect children’s emotional security.
Recognise intimidation, sarcasm, and verbal pressure.

modules.title: Fathering and Communication
modules.content: Explores how communication shapes children’s emotional world.

modules.title: Impact on Partner and Children
modules.content: Shows how harmful communication creates fear and instability.

modules.title: Safe and Respectful Communication
modules.content: Provides tools for calm, clear, and respectful interactions.
